title: ITV / Type voices in motion

location.extent: Whole original clip; PNG is one representative frame

slide_intent: Match font, scale and movement to a phrase’s emotional tone while preserving reading order, because letterforms shape the tone and reading emphasis of a message.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen a recognizable voice across different programme moods.
demonstration: The reel changes between serif, italic and sans forms, varied spacing, stacked repetitions and highlighted words on dark or green fields. Phrases include ESPIONAGE, INCREDIBLE and new season.
practical_value: Match font, scale and movement to a phrase’s emotional tone while preserving reading order.
